STAMPED, NOT MOVED. The floor carried no `measured_at` at all, so it was a number nobody could reproduce: the guard that refuses a stamp this branch never had cannot fire on a floor with no stamp, and an unstamped floor may never have been true of any tree. Re-measured on a clean detached worktree at the stamped commit -- python odoo/tooling/architecture/order_line_qty.py --roots enterprise --count -- and it reads 152, equal to the floor. The count does not move; only the stamp does. A sibling floor's stamp is the SIBLING's commit, recorded through `--update --root enterprise` from a clean detached worktree of that checkout, so it resolves in the repository that was actually measured.

PREVIOUS NOTE, kept because a floor that loses its history costs more than the stamp gains:

First baseline for this scope. `architecture.yml` in the community fork invokes order_line_qty.py without `--roots`, so it measures `odoo/` and `addons/` and this repository was checked by nothing -- a regression here was caught by nothing and a fix here credited by nothing. Measured 152 with `order_line_qty.py --roots enterprise --count` on 2026-08-28.
